name: io.github.tonyyang0504/impact_com-mcp
description: impact.com (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_ACCOUNT_SID
environmentVariables.description: Account SID of a Brand API access token (impact.com > user profile > Settings > Technical > API > Create Access Token); the HTTP Basic username and the {AccountSID} in every path.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The token's Auth Token, the HTTP Basic password. Needs read scope for programs and reports.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_REPORT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Report handle for get_report, taken from GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Reports (Id of a report with ApiAccessible=true, e.g. a performance-by-day report); its columns are listed by /Reports/{ReportId}/MetaData.
